Example small mutations with a kataegis cluster

Source: R/data.R
ex_snv.Rd

Synthetic SNVs for sample "EXAMPLE01" on chr7, in the format plot_sv_linear() expects for its optional snv_data panel: a localised kataegis shower of APOBEC-like C>N substitutions over the EGFR amplicon (short intermutation distances) plus a few scattered background SNVs. Passed to plot_sv_linear(snv_data = ex_snv) it adds a rainfall panel in which the kataegis cluster dips toward the bottom.

Usage

ex_snv

Format

A data.frame with columns sampleID, seqnames, start, allelic_freq, variant_cn, type, ref, mut.

Source

Synthetic; generated by data-raw/make_example_data.R.

See also

plot_sv_linear(), ex_plot_inputs

Examples

p <- plot_sv_linear(
  sample   = "EXAMPLE01",
  cnv_data = ex_plot_inputs$cnv_data,
  sv_data  = ex_plot_inputs$sv_data,
  chromosome = "chr7", chromosome_range = matrix(c(54e6, 56e6), nrow = 1),
  snv_data = ex_snv
)
